SBP=$(cat /tmp/sbp_token 2>/dev/null); python3 - "$SBP" <<'EOF'
import json, subprocess, sys, urllib.parse, datetime
SBP=sys.argv[1]
def logs(sql, start, end):
    u='https://api.supabase.com/v1/projects/kvclcdjmjghndxsngfzb/analytics/endpoints/logs.all?sql='+urllib.parse.quote(sql)+f'&iso_timestamp_start={start}&iso_timestamp_end={end}'
    p=subprocess.run(['curl','-s','--max-time','55','-H',f'Authorization: Bearer {SBP}',u],capture_output=True,text=True)
    try: return json.loads(p.stdout).get('result',p.stdout[:200])
    except Exception: return p.stdout[:300]
now=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ')
print('checked at:', now)
sql="select id, auth_logs.timestamp, event_message from auth_logs where event_message like '%request completed%' and event_message like '%\"grant_type\":\"password\"%' order by timestamp asc limit 200"
rows=logs(sql,'2026-07-18T04:12:00Z',now)
SANDBOX={'34.169.237.253','35.252.137.212'}
device=[]
for r in rows if isinstance(rows,list) else []:
    m=json.loads(r['event_message'])
    ip=m.get('remote_addr')
    tag='SANDBOX' if ip in SANDBOX else 'DEVICE'
    print(m['time'],'|',m.get('status'),'|',ip,'|',tag)
    if tag=='DEVICE': device.append(m)
print('--- device attempts since repair:', len(device))
EOF
